dale_hatch.says: MY GUYS ARE SWAMPED, SO HERE I AM. SAFETY ON THIS ONE, SON. FRANKIE ALWAYS DID MY USED ONES.

letter.title: HATCH MOTORS
lines: FROM THE DESK OF DALE HATCH
A FAIR PRICE. FOR FRANK'S KIDS.

local.line: THE MOUNTAIN TIM'S. FRANKIE AND I USED TO SIT IN THAT LOT. HE TOOK IT BLACK. CHECKED HIS BRAKES EVERY SUNDAY, TOO. CAREFUL MAN.

clue.note: HATCH KNOWS DAD CHECKED HIS BRAKES EVERY SUNDAY. SO DID EVERYBODY, I GUESS.

APPROVED.line: "Good man. Frankie's boy." He tucks the card under the mug. "Think about it. For Aries." You never told him her name.

DENIED.line: He laughs like it's a joke you both told. "Sure, son. Sure." There was nothing wrong with it. He knows you know.

REPORT.line: Constable Tremblay looks at the papers, looks at Hatch, and buys him a coffee. Then she looks at you for a long time.

WRENCH.line: "Off the books? Son, I sell cars. Everything I do is on the books." He smiles. Gus puts his coffee down.

darrell_trade.says: SAFETY ON THE DAKOTUH. TRADING IT IN AT HATCH'S. LOW KAYS. GARAGE-KEPT. THE GARAGE IS OUTSIDE.

odo_rollback.line: THE ODOMETER'S BRAND NEW. WELL. NOT NEW. IT'S FROM A DIFFERENT TRUCK. HATCH'S GUYS DO IT ALL DAY. SHH.

clue.note: DARRELL SAYS HATCH'S LOT WINDS BACK ODOMETERS "ALL DAY." DARRELL SAYS A LOT OF THINGS.

local.line: I DON'T DRINK COFFEE. MEDIUM DOUBLE-DOUBLE. THE MOUNTAIN ONE.

APPROVED.line: Darrell drives off honking. Three days later Hatch Motors lists it online: LOW KMS! ONE OWNER! SAFETIED AT COVINGTON AUTO.

DENIED.line: "Fair. Fair. I'll go to Lindsay's." He winks. "Don't tell Hatch's guys about the kays. They think it's a low-mileage truck."

REPORT.line: Constable Tremblay writes it up as "a paperwork thing." Darrell waves from the back of the cruiser. He seems happy for the ride.
